newsitem.title: INDIA: Three die in India as military shell explodes.
newsitem.headline: Three die in India as military shell explodes.

text.p: A man and his parents were killed in eastern India when a shell he picked up from a beach exploded, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said on Thursday.

The news agency said Pada Koili picked up four unexploded shells, which were among those dropped from a helicopter by Indian defence scientists at Chandipur in the coastal state of Orissa as part of warhead testing.
The family had probably collected the shells for the brass, PTI said.
